programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: वचन दिले तु मला

programme.title: அழகே அழகு
programme.desc: ஆண்கள் ஆதிக்கம் நிறைந்த குடும்பத்தில் திருமணம் செய்துகொண்ட ஒரு பழமைவாதியும் ஒரு நவீன பெண்ணும், மரபுகளை சமாளிக்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கண்மணி அன்புடன்
programme.desc: இரண்டு நெருங்கிய தோழிகளான கண்மணி மற்றும் வெண்ணிலா ஒரே ஆணை காதலிக்கும் போது அவர்களின் நட்பு சோதனைக்கு உட்படுகிறது.

programme.title: தென்றலே மெல்ல பேசு
programme.desc: தைரியமான பெண் இளமதி ஒரு துணிச்சலான போலீஸ்காரர் மற்றும் ஒரு பொறுப்பற்ற குண்டர்களுடன் முக்கோணக் காதலில் சிக்கி கொள்கிறாள்.

programme.title: சுட்டும் விழி சுடரே ஒரு சின்னஞ்சிறு குயிலின் காதை
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி தொலைக்காட்சியில் மிகவும் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருகின்றது.

programme.title: சின்ன மருமகள் பனிரெண்டாம் வகுப்பு
programme.desc: ஒரு பெண்ணின் மருத்துவம் படிக்க வேண்டும் என்ற ஆசை ஆணாதிக்க குடும்பத்து பையனுடனான அவளது நிச்சயதார்த்தத்தால் தடையானது.

programme.title: ஒண்ணா இருக்க கத்துக்கணும்
programme.desc: ஒரு சிறிய சைவ உணவகத்தை நடத்தி வரும் கந்தசாமி குடும்பம், இந்திரா என்ற நவீனப் பெண்ணின் வருகையால் ஏற்படும் மாற்றங்களை எதிர்கொள்ள வேண்டும்.

programme.title: தாய் மாமன்- தாய்க்கு நிகரானவன்
programme.desc: மாயாண்டி மற்றும் பேச்சி குடும்பத்தில் ஏற்பட்ட பிளவால் எதிரிகளாக மாறுகிறார்கள். இருப்பினும், பழிவாங்கும் விதமாக அவர்கள் தங்கள் பிள்ளைகளுக்கு திருமணம் செய்து வைக்கும்போது, ​​நிலைமை தலைகீழாக மாறுகிறது.

programme.title: அய்யனார் துணை
programme.desc: தன் நான்கு சகோதரர்கள் மற்றும் தந்தையுடன் வாழும் கணவருடைய வீட்டில் சவால்களை சமாளிக்க முயலும் புதிதாக திருமணமான ஒரு பெண்.

programme.title: சிறகடிக்க ஆசை
programme.desc: மீனாவும், பிரச்சனைகள் நிறைந்த கடந்தகாலத்தை கொண்ட முத்துக்குமாரும் திருமண வாழ்க்கையில் பல சிரமங்களை எதிர்கொள்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: பாண்டியன் ஸ்டோர்ஸ் தந்தை சொல் மிக்க மந்திரம் இல்லை
programme.desc: மணமாகாத மூன்று சோம்பேறி மகன்கள் வாழ்வில் போராடும் போது அவர்களது தந்தயோ தொடர்பு கொள்ளும்போது நகைச்சுவைக்கு வழிவகுக்கிறது.

programme.title: காதல் காதல் காதல்
programme.desc: தனது வீட்டை முழுமையான அதிகாரத்துடன் நிர்வகித்து வரும் கரிகாலன், தந்தையின் கண்டிப்பான கட்டுப்பாடுகள் அடங்கிய வாழ்க்கை அவரது மகன்களின் ரகசிய காதல் வெளிப்படும்போது முறியத் தொடங்குகிறது.

programme.title: அழகே அழகு
programme.desc: ஆண்கள் ஆதிக்கம் நிறைந்த குடும்பத்தில் திருமணம் செய்துகொண்ட ஒரு பழமைவாதியும் ஒரு நவீன பெண்ணும், மரபுகளை சமாளிக்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: டிடபிள்யூஆர் ட்ரான்ஸ் வர்ல்ட் ரேடியோ
programme.desc: பல்வேறு மத போதகர்கள் கிறிஸ்துவின் போதனைகளை விளக்கி, பின்பற்றுபவர்களை பக்திமயமான வாழ்க்கை வாழ ஊக்குவிக்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: சுட்டும் விழி சுடரே ஒரு சின்னஞ்சிறு குயிலின் காதை
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி தொலைக்காட்சியில் மிகவும் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருகின்றது.

programme.title: கலக்கப்போவது யாரு

programme.desc: Sub-inspector Dibakar Singho settles every dispute in his town with wisdom and logic. However, he is compelled to use force when an extortionist with mafia links - Arjun Sarkar - confronts him.

programme.desc: When Kamala's marriage is called off due to lack of dowry, Ananda saves her reputation by marrying her. Later, he abandons her on realising that she is unable to read and write.

programme.desc: An anthology of three stories of individuals who react differently to crime and face unexpected consequences as a result of their actions.

programme.desc: Aditya, a commitment-phobic hotelier, loves Esha, his innocent employee. Things get complicated when Esha's past comes to the fore, and he realises that Prachi, his associate, loves him.

programme.title: One
programme.desc: An aspiring policeman embarks on an unauthorised mission to investigate a devious scientist. However, he confronts various challenges when his actions are exposed.

programme.desc: A detective is assigned the responsibility of investigating a gang of poachers suspected of illegally hunting wild elephants in the forest.

programme.title: Happy Husbands

programme.desc: Ill-treated since childhood by the wealthy people, Kayamkulam Kochunni decides to steal from the rich and feed the poor and the lower caste community, thus growing into a hero for the downtrodden.

programme.title: Loham
programme.desc: When Jayanthi's husband, Ramesh, who is accused in a gold smuggling case, goes missing, she comes to Kochi to find him. In her quest to locate him, she comes across Raju, a taxi driver.

programme.title: Ring Master
programme.desc: Prince, a dog trainer, faces an awkward situation when his pet dog Diana acts in a film alongside his former lover, an actress who shares the same name as the dog.

programme.title: Janamaithri

programme.title: RDX

programme.title: Mambazhakkalam
programme.desc: When his father dies, Chandran is forced to go abroad to earn money to pay his father's dues. On a holiday to India, he meets his childhood lover and hopes to rekindle the relationship.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

On hand with their expert advice is store owner and wedding dress designer, Christine Dando and creator of Princess Diana's infamous wedding dress, David Emanuel. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. programme.title: All Girls Garage
programme.desc: Ladies, start your engines! `All Girls Garage' taps into the expertise of three women repairing cars and motorcycles in a shop setting. The `girls' are certified mechanic Sarah Lateiner, who goes by the nickname `Bogi'; TV host and motorsports reporter Cristy Lee; and mobile automotive repair pioneer Faye Hadley. Producers say the women approach complex projects - from upgrading the RAM Air on a rare Pontiac GTO Judge, to installing an exhaust system on a V10 Audi, to repairing a Suzuki Hyabusa motorcycle - that rival those undertaken by their male counterparts in order to prove they have what it takes to run a female-dominated car shop.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Car enthusiast Mike Brewer works alongside mechanics to give new life to rundown, classic automobiles in order to resell at a profit. Working with a limited budget, Mike's job is to find and purchase a vehicle and oversee all the necessary repairs - and usually there are plenty of them - giving tips along the way about electrics, structural issues, mechanics, cosmetic touches and finishing work. Once complete, the restored car is taken for a test drive, and then Mike negotiates the purchase price with a new owner. The first 13 seasons of `Wheeler Dealers' featured master mechanic Edd China as Brewer's sidekick.

programme.title: Bad Chad Customs
programme.desc: In rural Canning, Nova Scotia, sits a modest auto body shop whose proprietor has built a legendary reputation. He's known in town as a custom car artist "who can build a Bugatti out of a chicken coop", a neighbour says. Now, Chad Hiltz, aka `Bad Chad', is ready to expand his horizons, helped in no small part by this series that airs across North America. It shows how Hiltz incorporates literally anything into his car builds - parts from boats, airplanes, even old lockers - and uses basic tools and lots of ingenuity. Isolated and cash poor, Chad's creations spring from a mind that never stops. If he can imagine it, he will find a way to build it. The series also features, among others, Chad's shop manager and fiancee, Jolene, and son Colton.

programme.title: Houdini's Last Secrets
programme.desc: Cracking a magician's code used to be strictly against industry standards. Now, it seems the magic has disappeared from that concept, and even legendary performers such as Harry Houdini are not immune. This series looks to uncover the methods to Houdini's breathtaking escapes and astonishing illusions, which have never been equalled or fully understood. How did this showman catch a speeding bullet, submerge himself in a water torture cell, or survive being buried alive? Helping piece together clues and testing out his most daring stunts are Houdini's grand-nephew George Hardeen, magician and daredevil Lee Terbosic, and master stunt builder Steve Wolf.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress UK
programme.desc: This is a UK version of the popular US series `Say Yes to the Dress', the show where wives-to-be are united with their perfect bridal dress. Set in Essex, the Confetti and Lace bridal boutique welcomes customers from all over the UK as they seek to find the wedding dress of their dreams. On hand with their expert advice is store owner and wedding dress designer, Christine Dando and creator of Princess Diana's infamous wedding dress, David Emanuel. The pair do everything in their power to make the day a special experience for each unique bride who also shares their personal anecdotes with the crew.

programme.desc: Inside Kleinfeld Bridal, the Manhattan-based bridal salon that is arguably the world's finest, more than 250 professionals, most of them veterans from the shop's early days in Brooklyn, bend over backward to make each bride's experience unforgettable. Part bridal story, part fashion makeover and part family therapy session, each episode looks at the personalities and craftsmanship that come into play as the Kleinfeld staff go to sometimes extreme lengths to realize each bride's dreams.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress UK
programme.desc: This is a UK version of the popular US series `Say Yes to the Dress', the show where wives-to-be are united with their perfect bridal dress. Set in Essex, the Confetti and Lace bridal boutique welcomes customers from all over the UK as they seek to find the wedding dress of their dreams. On hand with their expert advice is store owner and wedding dress designer, Christine Dando and creator of Princess Diana's infamous wedding dress, David Emanuel. The pair do everything in their power to make the day a special experience for each unique bride who also shares their personal anecdotes with the crew.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Inside Kleinfeld Bridal, the Manhattan-based bridal salon that is arguably the world's finest, more than 250 professionals, most of them veterans from the shop's early days in Brooklyn, bend over backward to make each bride's experience unforgettable. Part bridal story, part fashion makeover and part family therapy session, each episode looks at the personalities and craftsmanship that come into play as the Kleinfeld staff go to sometimes extreme lengths to realize each bride's dreams.

programme.title: ஃபோர்ஜ்ட் இன் ஃபையர்: நைஃப் ஆர் டெத்
programme.desc: உலகின் பல்வேறு பகுதிகளை சேர்ந்த போட்டியாளர்கள் போட்டியை வெல்ல ஆயுதங்களின் உதவியுடன் தடைகளை தாண்டி வெல்ல முயல்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: பாவ்ன் ஸ்டார்ஸ்
programme.desc: கலைப்பொருட்களை வாங்கி, விற்று மற்றும் மதிப்பீடு செய்யும் அடகு கடை வைத்திருக்கும் ரிக் ஹாரிசன் மற்றும் அவர் குடும்பம்.

programme.title: த ஃபாஸ்ட் ஹிஸ்டரி ஆஃப்
programme.desc: பிரபல நிறுவனங்களின் கடந்த காலங்கள், யுஎஃப்ஒக்கள்-கோடீஸ்வரர்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை போன்ற விஷயங்களை பற்றி ஆராயும் ஒரு நபர்.

programme.title: ஹிஸ்ட்ரி'ஸ் க்ரேட்டஸ்ட் ஹீஸ்ட்ஸ் வித் பியர்ஸ் ப்ரோஸ்னன்
programme.desc: உலக வரலாற்றில் சிறந்த திருட்டுகள் மற்றும் அவற்றின் பின்னணியில் உள்ள சூத்திரதாரிகளை இயக்குனர் விளக்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அமெரிக்கன் பிக்கர்ஸ்
programme.desc: மறக்கப்பட்ட நினைவுச்சின்னங்கள், பழைய எலக்ட்ரானிக்ஸ் மற்றும் வாகனங்களை அழகான சேகரிப்புகளாக மாற்றும் தொகுப்பாளர்கள்.

programme.title: டார்க் மார்வல்ஸ்
